source_text.body:
Sweep email and sync calendars each morning
A user has Claude, via Chrome, access Outlook email and calendar at 7:30 a.m., copy events into Gmail calendar, summarize and prioritize email, and track tasks.
·
Jul 1, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
CH
Claude in Chrome
What they did
One commenter said they had Claude use Chrome to open Outlook email and calendar because their IT team blocked normal calendar syncing. They set it to run automatically at 7:30 a.m. to sweep both email accounts and both calendars, copy Outlook events into Gmail Calendar, and summarize and prioritize email; afterward, they do a “brain dump,” and Claude tracks and reprioritizes tasks, carrying over unfinished work from the day before.
How it went
They describe it as life-changing and say it became a pseudo-productivity app that also tracks projects and notices when they are avoiding a task, sometimes helping start it. The post gives no hard metrics, and they note they do not work with sensitive data.
Worth knowing
The main catch is access: this worked by letting Claude drive Outlook through a web browser after direct calendar syncing was blocked by IT.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Every weekday at [7:30 a.m.], open my Outlook email and calendar in the browser. Copy any new events into my Gmail calendar without creating duplicates, then summarize my unread email and rank it by priority, and add any action items to a task list. Do not reply, delete, or send anything; show me the summary and the list of calendar changes before you make them, and stop once I've approved.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1uyfr0w/question_for_those_with_adhd_or_dyslexia
